title: "sanderia_annotation"
format: html

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

sa.interpro = read_tsv(file="../../sanderia/annotations/interpro/Sanma_proteome_1p1g_clean.tsv",quote = "")
sa.interpro$trancriptID <- gsub("^Sanma[-_]", "", sa.interpro$trancriptID)
gene_table.sa <- read.table(file="../../data/seqs/genomes/Sanderia/Sanma_gene_transcript_protein_table.tsv", header=F)
names(gene_table.sa)[names(gene_table.sa)=="V1"] <- "gene_id"
names(gene_table.sa)[names(gene_table.sa)=="V2"] <- "transcript_id"
names(gene_table.sa)[names(gene_table.sa)=="V3"] <- "protein_id"

sa.interpro <- sa.interpro %>%
  left_join(gene_table.sa, by = c('trancriptID'='protein_id'))

OMA.AcSa <- read_tsv(file= "../../data/OMA/kostya-sa_repaired.tsv", quote="")

#Filtering the output file which has comments at the top and bottom
lines <- readLines("../../sanderia/annotations/eggnog/sanderia.emapper.annotations")

# header is the line starting with "#query"
header_idx <- which(grepl("^#query", lines))
header <- strsplit(sub("^#", "", lines[header_idx]), "\t")[[1]]

# data lines are everything that doesn't start with "#"
data_lines <- lines[!grepl("^#", lines)]

sa.eggnog <- read_tsv(paste(data_lines, collapse = "\n"), col_names = header)
sa.eggnog$query <- gsub("^Sanma[-_]", "", sa.eggnog$query)
sa.eggnog <- sa.eggnog %>%
  left_join(gene_table.sa, by = c('query'='protein_id'))

Sa_TF_table <- read.csv(file = '../../data/seqs/TF_lists/SanMa_TF_list_split.csv')

Sa_TF_table <- Sa_TF_table %>%
  distinct(GeneID, .keep_all = TRUE)

Sa_TF_table$GeneID <- sub("\\..*$", "", Sa_TF_table$GeneID)
Sa_TF_table$ProteinID <- sub("\\..*$", "", Sa_TF_table$ProteinID)

library(ggvenn)
ggvenn(list(eggNOG = sa.eggnog$gene_id, InterProScan = sa.interpro$gene_id, OMA_AcSa = OMA.AcSa$Gene.Sa , TFs = Sa_TF_table$GeneID))


sa.annotations <- gene_table.sa %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    transcript_id = paste(transcript_id, collapse = ","),
    protein_id = paste(protein_id, collapse = ",")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sa.annotations <- sa.annotations %>%
  left_join(sa.eggnog, by = c('gene_id'='gene_id'))

sa.annotations <- sa.annotations %>%
  left_join(sa.interpro, by = c('gene_id'='gene_id'))

combine_go <- function(go_eggnog, go_ips) {
  # split each on commas (handle NA/"-"/empty as no GO terms)
  split_clean <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || x == "-" || x == "") return(character(0))
    terms <- strsplit(x, ",")[[1]]
    # strip anything in parentheses, e.g. "GO:0005737(PANTHER)" -> "GO:0005737"
    terms <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", terms)
    # trim any stray whitespace just in case
    trimws(terms)
  }
  
  eggnog_terms <- split_clean(go_eggnog)
  ips_terms <- split_clean(go_ips)
  
  combined <- union(eggnog_terms, ips_terms)
  
  if (length(combined) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(combined, collapse = ",")
}

sa.annotations$GO_combined <- mapply(combine_go, sa.annotations$GOs, sa.annotations$GO)

sa.annotations <- sa.annotations%>%
  relocate(GO, .after = GOs)
sa.annotations <- sa.annotations%>%
  relocate(GO_combined, .after = GO)

load (file= "../../data/scyphozoa_AGC/ACOE.genes.RData")

ac_to_sa.names <- OMA.AcSa %>%
  left_join(genes.ac %>% select(cellranger,gene_short_name), by=c('Gene.Ac'='cellranger'))

ac_to_sa.names <- ac_to_sa.names %>%
  filter(pairing %in% c('1:1','many:1'))

pattern <- "^[A-Z]+[0-9]+G[0-9]+$"
ac_to_sa.names <- ac_to_sa.names %>%
  filter(!grepl(pattern, gene_short_name))

ac_to_sa.names <- ac_to_sa.names %>%
  group_by(Gene.Sa) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_short_name = paste(gene_short_name, collapse = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sa.annotations <- sa.annotations %>%
  left_join(ac_to_sa.names, by=c('gene_id'='Gene.Sa'))

sa.annotations <- sa.annotations %>%
  left_join(Sa_TF_table %>% select(TF_Fam,GeneID), by = c('gene_id'='GeneID'))

sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations %>% 
  select(gene_id, transcript_id.x,protein_id, eggNOG_OGs,Description,Preferred_name,GO_combined,KEGG_ko,KEGG_Pathway,PFAMs,
         SUPERFAMILY_IPS_Desc,Pfam_IPS_Desc,TF_Fam,gene_short_name)

sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations_light %>%
  mutate(
    name = coalesce(
      na_if(gene_short_name, "-"),
      na_if(Preferred_name, "-"),
      na_if(gene_id, "-")
    )
  )

sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations_light %>%
  select(-gene_short_name)

sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations_light %>%
  relocate(name, .after = gene_id)

names(sa.annotations_light)[names(sa.annotations_light)=="transcript_id.x"] <- "transcript_id"

sp.lines <- readLines("../../sanderia/annotations/signalP/predicition_positive_clean.txt")

# the real header is the line starting with "# ID"
sp.header_line <- sp.lines[grepl("^# ID", sp.lines)]
sp.header <- strsplit(sub("^# ", "", sp.header_line), "\t")[[1]]

# data lines: skip anything starting with "#"
sp.data_lines <- sp.lines[!grepl("^#", sp.lines)]

sa.signalP <- read_tsv(paste(sp.data_lines, collapse = "\n"), col_names = sp.header)

sa.signalP$ID <- gsub("^Sanma[-_]", "", sa.signalP$ID)
sa.signalP <- sa.signalP %>%
  left_join(gene_table.sa, by= c('ID'='protein_id'))

names(sa.signalP)[names(sa.signalP)=="Prediction"] <- "SP-prediction"

sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations_light %>%
  left_join(sa.signalP %>% select(gene_id, `SP-prediction`), by = c('gene_id'='gene_id'))
sa.annotations_light <- sa.annotations_light %>%
  relocate(Preferred_name, .after = name)

write.table(sa.annotations_light, file = "../../sanderia/annotations/sanderia_func_annotations.tsv", sep = "\t", 
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


```
